text: Thirty-two thousand soldiers marched out to crush a city of just seven thousand.
It was November, thirteen twenty-five, in northern Italy.
Bologna and Modena had hated each other for generations.
And Modena had just stolen one of Bologna's castles.
So Bologna sent a gigantic army.
Knights. Archers. Banners as far as the eye could see.
Modena looked at those numbers... and attacked anyway.
By nightfall, Bologna's giant army was running home.
Modena chased them all the way to the city walls.
Then, right outside the gates, they held a horse race. Just to rub it in.
On the way back, a soldier spotted a well, with a wooden bucket.
Today, everyone says this war was fought over a stolen bucket.
And seven hundred years later, Modena still keeps it on display.
